title: SourceVersionV5
description: One exact byte state of a source artifact. This node is what an evidence anchor is ultimately about: an anchor that resolved against these bytes stays true about these bytes forever, and a later version does not silently inherit that truth. Emitted as a `source.version` node by `register_sources()` in `scripts/wi.py` during `wi ingest`; consumed by `wi impact` (which diffs two versions to compute the exact stale set), `wi anchor`, and the `sources/sources.lock` member of a `.wiab` bundle. Every version of an artifact shares the artifact's logical id in `artifact` and has its own version logical id derived from the file name plus the blob digest, so supersession is a chain rather than an overwrite.

logical_id.description: Derived by `logical_id("source_version", <file name>, <blob_digest>)`. Two ingests of identical bytes produce the same version id, so re-ingesting an unchanged file is a no-op rather than a new state.

artifact.description: Logical id of the SourceArtifactV5 this is a version of. The join that lets 'the same document' and 'the same bytes' be asked separately.

blob_digest.description: SHA-256 over the source's RAW BYTES, taken before any decoding, Unicode normalization, whitespace folding or text extraction. This is deliberate and load-bearing: normalizing first would mean an upgrade to the normalizer could change a source's identity without the source changing, so a proof could move while no source moved. Every derived, normalized object is hashed separately with `state_digest()`, which is domain-separated from this value so a byte stream and a semantic object can never be confused for one another. See references/v5/CANONICAL_HASHING.md section 3.

byte_length.description: Length of the raw bytes. Recorded alongside the digest so a truncated fetch is visible as a length mismatch before anyone has to compare hashes, and so byte offsets in an anchor can be bounds-checked without loading the source.

state_digest.description: Digest of this version node's canonical payload under `state_digest(payload, "source_version")`, binding schema id and normalization version into the preimage. This is the node's state identity in the graph and is NOT the same value as `blob_digest`, which addresses the bytes.

supersedes.description: Logical ids of earlier versions of the same artifact that this version replaces. In the executable core this relation is stored as `supersedes` edges rather than as a field on the node payload; it is expressed here as an array because a consumer reading a version record in isolation still needs the chain to know whether an anchor is pointing at current bytes.

media_type.description: Media type as ingested for this specific byte state. Present because an artifact can change format between versions without changing identity.

ingested_at.description: When these bytes entered the workspace object store.

logical_id.description: A UUID-shaped, content-derived logical identity produced by `logical_id()`.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest in the canonical `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>` form used everywhere in v5.

timestamp.description: ISO-8601 instant with an explicit UTC offset.
